says: In ticket 766's plan for our tooling (today's version), no law covers .agents/skills/lead/scripts/sys/LockFs.ts, the Lock service's real layer: a pid file written with the wx flag and reclaimed when its pid is dead. S5's only lock law runs on LockTest, so the real layer's reclaim of a dead holder and its refusal of a live one are unpinned.
proof: The plan at c756f02: line 474 is the Files row for sys/LockFs.ts (build, S5, 50 lines); the Laws table's one lock law, line 420, reads 'Two runs in one folder never hold the .npmrc swap at once' with the generator 'fc.integer: 2 to 4 runs at once on LockTest', and no Laws row names LockFs or the pid reclaim.
cost: The port can break the reclaim or let two runs hold the lock at once with no law going red, and two redact runs in one folder would then swap the .npmrc at the same time.
